version_order_note: Assigned navigation ordinal, not an asserted chronology or actual historical invocation count.
associated_runs_semantics: These are related E source/cohort wrappers, not a claim that every failed and completed attempt was pooled into this report.
exact_membership_status: Consult linked native hashes/audits for file/case membership; this import does not invent an unrecorded historical input list.
code_provenance_note: Referenced current archive files are not asserted to be the executed historical versions. Use native snapshots/hashes when available; otherwise execution code/command remain MISSING.
figure_lineage_note: Source data/plotting identity follow linked native analyses/code where explicitly bound. Adjacent files alone do not establish exact figure lineage; unresolved source/command bindings remain MISSING.
limitations: No report or metric was recomputed. Existing failed, corrected and superseded outputs stay in place.
Physical attempts, shared reports, source aliases and common prefixes are not independent extra samples. Their costs must not be summed blindly.
File hashes identify preserved artifacts at review time; they do not create execution provenance.
shared_evidence_note: The same preserved report/figure can be linked from several E records. Such a link neither transfers producer ownership nor creates a distinct analysis execution or independent sample.
